heading: Dining Venues

inRoom.heading: In-room Dining
description: Enjoy your meal in the comfort of your own room, without worrying about the surroundings.
It is ideal for family trips or couples looking for a peaceful moment together.
inRoom.note: Depending on the number of guests or group size, meals may be served in a private dining room.

hall.heading: Banquet Hall
description: Enjoy dinner and breakfast in a traditional banquet hall with other guests.
The atmosphere reflects the feel of a hot spring inn.
hall.note: Dinner and breakfast are both available in the banquet hall depending on the plan.

planNote: The dining venue depends on the lodging plan.
Please check each lodging plan for details.
